title: Gateway security changes fail strict Clippy gate
description: Robustness review gate found four strict lint regressions in modified gateway source: nonminimal recipient rollback predicate in gateway.rs, collapsible OSCORE option duplicate check, needless borrow in handoff request decode, and GatewayChallengeIssuer::verify_identity exceeding argument bound. Refactor without weakening checks and rerun all-target clippy -D warnings.
